The retired brain/cython/aegis_hotspot.pyx is not built; the live T5b regex accelerator (brain/cython) keeps its build inside python-tests.

QUARANTINED_P0 (GAP-007, migration slice PEP-001) - duplicate PEP + WFP enforcement; screening helper only, NOT an enforcement authority. Build+test run in the `shield-build` job. Non-gating by contract: the runtime loads sec_monitor.dll DynLib-style with a fail-safe default (no DLL/symbol => `unknown` verdict, prior behavior bit-identical; src/policy/shield_screen.zig), so a missing shield never breaks canonical health. See runtime_manifest.json rust_shield_tier3 for full quarantine status.
Tier-2 analytics suite (brain/test_*.py). Ran nowhere in CI before CI-GAPS: pytest's target was tests/ only, so a broken brain module could pass every gate.
Optional standalone operator monitor (Defender/PowerShell/Firewall tail + DEFCON GUI). std-only; never linked into the runtime and holds no authority.
Complementary egui operator console. Reads state; no enforcement authority.

WFP callout + minifilter sources. Manual-only job (workflow_dispatch) until a hosted WDK run is observed green, so PRs carry no unverified red signal; operator build path stays scripts/build_drivers.bat and install drill DEPLOY-120 (E5) remains the verification gate.

tests/test_e2e.py is a legacy Phase-1 manual harness around bridge/aegis_bridge.exe, which the canonical build never produces (bridge/ is legacy C++ outside the build). A CI job would only re-print silent skips (green wash), so its absence is a decision; canonical integration coverage is zig build test + tests/runtime (phase-t) + python-tests + brain-tests.
